text:
sara: heads-up: us-west-2 dedicated pool 7 showing 95th pct tail jump ~120ms since 09:40. pattern aligns with heavy egress bursts from tenant:acme-inc.
dinesh: saw that, adding link to grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/abc/ewf?from=now-30m (reacted :eyes: by miguel)
miguel: can we see nic tx drops or kernel qdisc backlog? run `ss -s` and `ethtool -S ix0 | grep tx_` on node-7-12
sara: pasted node logs and `tc -s qdisc show dev eth0` output below:
```
qdisc mq 0: dev eth0 root refcnt 2
 backlog 12b requeues 0
qdisc fq_codel 0: dev eth0 parent 1:1 limit 10240p flows 64 quantum 1514 memory_limit 4Kb
  tx_bytes 123456789 tx_packets 987654 tx_errors 0
```
kate: interesting — fq_codel isn't dropping much, but egress rates for acme-inc hit a sustained 9Gbps, crowding other tenants' bursts.
ops-bot: ALERT: tenant-acme-inc egress throttle triggered on pool-7 at 2026-03-20T09:42:11Z — policy=soft_fairshare (link: /incidents/INC-8291)
miguel: can we shift acme-inc to its dedicated slice or apply per-tenant policer? what's cost impact if we reserve a small dedicated lane?
dinesh: rough calc: 5% reserved lane on pool-7 -> +$2.1k/month (capex on reserved bandwidth + perf delta)
ryan: alternative: scheduler tweak—enable transient preemptive reshuffle for 2m windows to keep p99 under 80ms. low code change: flip feature flag `enable_transient_reshuffle=true` on canary.
sara: I'm okay to flip on canary in eu-west first. will run canary rollout with `--window=2m --metric=p99_latency` and abort if >10% regress.
kate: also recommend adding KV-cache affinity for acme's common prefixes to reduce egress amplification. small config: `cache.affinity=tenant:acme-inc prefix:32`
miguel: pinging infra-sre for NIC queue monitoring and to pre-seed dedicated slice if we see repeat spikes. @infra-sre-team
dinesh: follow-up action items: 1) canary reshape in eu-west at 10:05, 2) reserve 5% lane as contingency, 3) add cache affinity rule, 4) postmortem if repeat within 72h. I'll own (reacted :white_check_mark: by sara)
sara: thanks. i'll start canary and post updates here. keeping ticket INC-8291 updated with logs.
